structuredContent.body:
## Verified operational context
- Run [43236417804](https://github.com/c933103/openrailwaystyle/actions/runs/43236417804) acquired eight China boxes and split four executed-query-limit boxes: the pending queue went from 12 to 16, not backwards. Both retained release generations were downloaded and SHA-256 verified; all 28 old payloads are unchanged, eight new ones were retained, all 36 validate, and other stage archives are unchanged.
- It stopped after provider capacity/transport failures. Recent signal acquisition also failed to connect. One bounded primary status-metadata GET timed out; no OSM query or duplicate acquisition was dispatched.

## Narrow repair
The railway-ways collector ignored Retry-After and could begin retries without fitting their full five-minute request window inside its acquisition envelope. Share the existing staged provider-pause logic, with injectable elapsed/wall clocks and sleep for fixtures. Preserve header-time deadlines through body errors, successful responses, later regions, change requests and query-limit subdivision. Recheck early wakes; defer before a request that cannot fit; retain the pending queue and completed payloads.

Source URLs, queries, cache identities, five-attempt ceiling, byte budgets, complete-only publication and scheduled intervals are unchanged. Dependency tracking now includes railway-ways as the third consumer of the shared pause/calendar helpers. This does not restore provider availability or implement a shared daily quota.

## Checks on b1636c8
- Seven deterministic new regressions failed before the fix.
- 155 focused tests passed, zero failures/skips.
- Full aggregate: 4,132 pass, zero failures, 16 existing environment-dependent skips (Node 24.22.1).
- Build, generated style equality and diff checks passed.
- Exact-head hosted CI and Codex code/security reviews required before merge.

## Operational boundary
DATA_SOURCES and URL/domain settings are untouched. Existing complete extract alternatives were only read. Merging a builder change naturally starts the existing serial acquisition coordinator; this consequence must be reconciled with current workflow ownership/provider availability before integration. No manual retry is part of this PR.
